briefing: Stocks fell broadly today, with the NASDAQ down 1.6% and the S&P 500 down 1.2%. The screener returned no candidates, so no new positions were opened. The 7 current holdings stay as they are, and the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules will close any that hit their levels. The $546 in cash is held until the market turns risk-on again.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, often moving into safer places such as cash or bonds. During these days, prices often keep falling in the short term. Many disciplined investors pause new buying until things calm down.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）指投資者轉趨審慎，沽售成長股等較高風險資產，並將資金轉投現金或債券等避險資產。在這類交易日，股價短期內往往持續受壓。因此，不少紀律嚴謹的投資者會暫停建倉，待市況回穩後再部署。

market_education.summary_en: Both major U.S. indexes fell together today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.6% and the S&P 500 dropped 1.2%. Because the tech-heavy NASDAQ fell more, investors seem to have pulled back mainly from higher-risk growth stocks. No news headlines were provided today, so this move cannot be tied to a specific report or event.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股兩大指數今日同步下跌，納斯達克指數下挫1.6%，標普500指數則回落1.2%。科技股比重較高的納指跌幅較深，反映資金主要從高風險成長股撤出。由於今日未有新聞資料，暫無法將跌勢歸因於特定報道或事件。
